Source: https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component (npm 0.5.0). The sole source change replaces `export default function` with `module.exports = function`. Expo Router 57 still uses query-string 7, which requires a CommonJS callable export. This backports the upstream linear-time security fix without changing Router versions. Remove this override when Expo Router supports the patched upstream module format. Regression tests cover decoding through query-string.
